name: Alpenhotel Weitlanbrunn
beschreibung: The Alpenhotel Weitlanbrunn is located at 1,200 meters above sea level in the Eastern Tyrol section of the Drau Valley. It features 38 rooms and suites with balconies and mountain views. The wellness area includes a Finnish sauna, steam bath, and outdoor pool. The kitchen emphasizes local products and traditional Tyrolean dishes. In summer, the nearby nature park serves as the starting point for hikes and mountain biking tours. In winter, the ski resorts of Hochpustertal and Kartitsch are directly accessible. Guests also benefit from free rental bikes and the ski bus.
